title: allium carinatum subsp. violaceum
intro: Allium carinatum subsp. violaceum, commonly known as keel-flowered rock garlic, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the Allium genus. This plant has been traditionally used to aid in the relief of colds, fever, and cough, attributed to its health benefits such as its potential to reduce inflammation and act as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of keel-flowered rock garlic include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sulfur compounds. The bioactive constituents of Allium carinatum subsp. violaceum contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
